description_en: Modifies the whitelist of a memory engine
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx modify-mem0-security-ips --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pxc-000000000 --security-ip-list 127.0.0.1,192.168.0.0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyMem0SecurityIps

parameters.help_en: The IP addresses in the whitelist group. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 白名单分组里的IP列表，多个IP白名单间用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: security_ip_list

parameters.help_en: The name of the whitelist group of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例的白名单分组名称
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en:
The modification mode of the whitelist. Valid values:

0: overwrites the whitelist group.
1: adds a whitelist group.
2: deletes a whitelist group
parameters.help_zh:
白名单修改模式，取值范围如下：

0：覆盖修改白名单分组；
1：新增白名单分组；
2：删除白名单分组
parameters.name: modify_mode

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝的详细原因

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en: The identity used for authentication in the request
AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_zh: 请求中用于鉴权的身份标识

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the identity used for authentication belongs

AuthPrincipalType.description_en:
The type of identity used for authentication in the request. Valid values:
SubUser: RAM user.
AssumedRoleUser: RAM role.
Federated: SSO federated identity
AuthPrincipalType.description_zh:
请求中用于鉴权的身份类型。具体取值为：
RAM 用户：SubUser
RAM 角色：AssumedRoleUser
SSO 联合身份：Federated

EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_zh: 加密后的完整诊断信息

NoPermissionType.description_en:
The type of the permission denial. Valid values:
ImplicitDeny: The resource owner has not granted the required permissions to the current user. Unauthorized operations are denied by default.
ExplicitDeny: The RAM policy configured by the resource owner explicitly denies the current user access to the corresponding resource
NoPermissionType.description_zh:
权限策略拒绝的类型，取值如下：
ImplicitDeny：资源持有者未配置相关权限策略给当前用户，缺省拒绝未授权的操作。
ExplicitDeny：资源持有者配置的RAM策略明确拒绝了当前用户访问对应的资源
